assumptions.assumption: The web server is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: The text calls it the public site and says readers hit the web server over HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database contains accounts and comments, which describe or identify people, as well as site records.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket contains public data.
assumptions.basis: The bucket holds published assets that readers fetch from the CDN.
